description:
Activate Reaping Willow by paying {2} due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron and removing two counters from it, returning Plague Belcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Plague Belcher enters, it triggers, putting two -1/-1 counters on Reaping Willow.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Plague Belcher, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.name: Reaping Willow
uses.cardState: with two or more counters on it
